attack.note: Almost all damage is Sinister Strike, Ambush, Garrote and Eviscerate. Autos matter only with Slice and Dice, Hemorrhage and Rupture.

poke.note: No poke at all. She works from Vanish stealth and teleports with Ambush, Cheap Shot or Garrote.

damage.note: Ambush, Mutilate Sinister Strike and a 3 point Eviscerate land inside about two seconds, plus a Garrote silence that stops escapes. Healing arrives too late. Wound Poison can halve healing but is a minor talent. Measured NGS data (40 games, win rate 0.325) says she is rare and has struggled.

good_into.why: Vanish into Ambush, Garrote silence and Eviscerate kill a low health priority target such as Valla or Kael'thas before they react.
Stealth teleports behind a target and Garrote silences blinks and dashes, so mobile ranged heroes cannot flee.
Cheap Shot stuns and blinds basic attack reliant assassins and Smoke Bomb gives 60 percent damage reduction against them.
Low health ranged damage dealers such as Valla and Kael'thas are the targets the guide names, and a Garrote silence plus Eviscerate kills them.

bad_into.why: A stun or silence while she is deep in the backline kills her, and Cloak of Shadows only covers a short window.
Heroes who reveal (Eye of Kilrogg, area damage, Nova scans) break her opener and she is weak when revealed.
Assassinate needs the target to be isolated, so a coordinated team with a front line protects its backline.
If the target survives the burst, she has little sustained damage or self heal and loses the trade.

wants_from_team: Hard CC and burst that she can follow or combo with (Garrosh, E.T.C., Abathur)
Early game strength since she is weak in lane
Teammates who can clear waves and camps
Large map with multiple objectives to roam
gives_team: Pick potential and silence on key targets
weaknesses: Susceptible to crowd control and reveals
evidence: Ambush, Cheap Shot, Garrote, Sinister Strike, Eviscerate
Smoke Bomb and Cloak of Shadows heroics
Icy Veins guide: counter pick against low health targets, weak PvE
Measured: about 1921 hero damage, 2117 siege per minute, 36 CC seconds, win rate 0.325 over only 40 games
owner_notes: Like Nova she looks for isolated picks and ganks. Can be good, but struggles against coordinated teams unless the player times engages very well. Weaker in team fights and stronger in the laning phase.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Sinister Strike, Ambush, Garrote and Eviscerate. Autos matter only with Slice and Dice, Hemorrhage and Rupture.
lens_notes.damage_reliability: Openers are targeted and teleport from stealth, but damage from anything (especially area damage) breaks stealth and removes the opener. Seal Fate wants a silenced, rooted or stunned target.
lens_notes.durability_source: Icy Veins lists a high HP pool, Vanish gives a one second Unrevealable window and Smoke Bomb gives 60 armor. Incredibly weak when revealed.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Vanish then Ambush, Cheap Shot or Garrote teleport (5 range after 3 seconds of stealth).
lens_notes.setup_reliance: Owner: she looks for isolated picks and ganks like Nova. Icy Veins says her damage works best as a follow up to a team initiation, so cleanup is the alternative reading.
lens_notes.utility_tool: Garrote silences for 2.5 seconds and interrupts channels. Cheap Shot stuns and then blinds.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Cloak of Shadows (15 second cooldown) removes damage over time and makes her Unstoppable for 1.5 seconds. Smoke Bomb is the other heroic and does not stop CC.
lens_notes.wave_clear_style: Icy Veins: weak PvE, Blade Flurry is her only clear and is energy hungry.
lens_notes.power_curve: Owner: weaker in team fights, stronger in the laning phase, which differs from the profile spike of mid. Followed the owner. Level 4 and 7 talents decide her power.
lens_notes.snowball: Picks give a lead, and a win rate of 0.325 over 40 NGS games (rare pick) says she does not recover when behind.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Both heroics (Smoke Bomb, Cloak of Shadows) are defensive. Icy Veins calls Cloak of Shadows strong against CC heavy teams.
lens_notes.team_needs: Icy Veins: heroes with reliable CC and burst, and Garrosh or E.T.C. to displace targets. She cannot clear waves herself.
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Icy Veins: heroes who break her from stealth, heavy CC, coordinated teams, and being revealed.

lens_gaps: vulnerable_to has no value for 'revealed' or area damage that breaks stealth (detection is not a counter value).
power_curve has no value for 'strong in lane and picks, fades in team fights' (owner read).
No lens for target class matchups: Valeera is a counter pick into assassins and low health priority targets.
